title: Explicit negation: batch-prefetch flag is NOT enabled in prod
notes: Tests negation across two environments at once — the flag is explicitly OFF in prod but explicitly ON in staging. An extractor must not conflate the two or drop either polarity.

turns.text: For the record, the experimental batch-prefetch flag is NOT enabled in prod — we turned it off after the regression last week.
So batch-prefetch is off in production. Is it still on in staging?
Yes, still on in staging so we can keep testing the fix, just disabled in prod until we're confident.
Clear: prod = disabled, staging = enabled, pending confidence before re-enabling in prod.

gold_atoms.text: The experimental batch-prefetch flag is NOT enabled in production — it was disabled after a regression.
The batch-prefetch flag remains enabled in staging for continued testing.

forbidden_items: The batch-prefetch flag is enabled in production
